name: playwright-bdd-pane
description: Azure DevOps extension: publish playwright-bdd reports and view them in a build results tab.

scripts.package: npm run build && tfx extension create --manifest-globs vss-extension.json --output-path out
scripts.package:dev: npm run build && tfx extension create --manifest-globs vss-extension.json --overrides-file vss-extension.dev.json --output-path out
